chapter: Early bands, Calloway to Basie and Kansas City (third typescript)
title: Zack Whyte, the Savoy, and his first record
summary: He joined Zack Whyte, came to New York to play the Savoy, and sang on his first released record without credit.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now

blocks.x: And then after that I joined Zack Way (PHONETIC).
Were these bands mostly working around the --
Well yeah -- in the Midwest, yeah. And Jack White (PHONETIC) -- I joined him. And we came here to New York with Zack and played Savoy. And that's where I made my first record that they released.
But I never got any -- what do they call -- no mentions on it. But I sang it and it was with Louis . And it was a piece of -- of -- I'm trying to -- Nesbitt (PHONETIC)
Johnnie Nesbitt (PHONETIC) was playing with Zack right at the time.
-- and so -- you know -- he was with the Mecanics. Anyway, (unintelligible) I don't know why I didn't get no -- I guess I sang so bad probably. Talking about that reminds me --
Yeah. I've heard it -- it's nice. Maybe they didn't put your name on -- they usually --

-- put my name on it nowhere. And Higgenbottom (PHONETIC) was in the band. He played the trombone solo and I did the singing you know. But it was a good chance to be on the stand you know. All I wanted to do -- I wanted to play really --
